message: `output` performs IO and its declaration does not say so
notes: effects are INFERRED transitively, so this fires on every function up the call chain, and each one is a place a reader would otherwise have to open the callee to learn it. If the effect is not wanted here the fix is to stop performing it, not to stop saying so. `IO`, `Entropy`, `Spawn` and `Block` are required; `Alloc` and `Mut` are ambient and never need declaring
